name: strategic-change
description: Consulting-framework skills for diagnosing and managing organizational change — DICE, Kotter's 8-Step, Technical vs. Adaptive, Theory E/O, Persuasion, Tipping Point, Immunity to Change, Six Steps, Productive Distress, Critical Few Behaviours, Dual Operating System, Network Position — plus a multi-framework assessment orchestrator and a change impact assessment generator that builds a baseline CIA workbook from a system implementation's own project documents.
